slicing.note: 技术审 granularity_review 判定单一 Batch：候选 installed engine lightweight vertical loop。S1 façade/admission/runtime 选择 → S2 StartRequest/intake receipt/canonical digest/envelope → S3 drive/submit/六类 NextResult → S4 terminal cleanup/Complete/replay → S5 installed 隔离、legacy 回归与 negative fixtures；共享未冻结的 façade、state.json、Store/CAS、typed protocol、envelope 和 cleanup 接口，拆成多个 Batch 无法独立验收或回滚且交接成本更高。Batch 内 Subtask 连续执行，不换代理。

cases.observation: Cleanup succeeds; install and uninstall are rejected on active candidate; target artifacts and snapshots unchanged.
cases.oracleResult: Oracle matched: install/uninstall fencing and artifact stability.
